name: North Central Coast
climate: Dry from about February to August. Heavy rain and typhoons are most likely from September to November.
days: Hue wants more than one night. Phong Nha is a separate overnight, usually from Dong Hoi or Hue.
summary: Central Vietnam’s northern coast, home to the old imperial city of Hue and the river caves of Phong Nha. Tour Hue’s citadel and royal tombs, take a boat into Phong Nha Cave, swim at Lang Co under the Hai Van Pass, or walk the rice terraces of Pu Luong. The driest weather is roughly February to August; September to November brings heavy rain.
body: Hue and Phong Nha sit on this coast. Dry weather is most likely from about February to August. Heavy rain and typhoons are most likely from September to November.
Phong Nha is a separate overnight, usually from Dong Hoi or Hue. Hue is a few hours north of Da Nang. Da Nang and Hoi An are the next region south.
seoDescription: Hue and Phong Nha: when this coast is dry, and how to split the nights.
